note: FireRed/LeafGreen overworld blocks. Each 32x32 block is one 16x16 GBA map tile drawn at 2x, so the world renders at twice the GBA scale (same as the 2x-scaled FRLG screen) and lines up with the 32px map grid in world.js. Blocks 0/1/2/15 are the same lawn tile, 5/6/7 the same shaded forest floor - town ground is deliberately free of per-cell variation.
source: The Spriters Resource - Pokemon FireRed/LeafGreen - Tileset pages: ground blocks re-cut from tileset-2 (regular 16px grid), buildings from the Buildings sheet, trees from the Tileset sheet
